trap.label: preposição fixa
trap.wrong: We attribute the growth at teamwork.
trap.right: We attribute the growth to teamwork.
trap.why: Em português “atribuir a” sugere to, mas o brasileiro mistura com “por/em”. Em inglês, attribute A TO B; na passiva, is attributed to.

fix.wrong: The result is attributed for luck.
fix.right: The result is attributed to luck.

fix.wrong: They attribute the dip on prices.
fix.right: They attribute the dip to prices.

fix.wrong: I can’t tell one twin to the other.
fix.right: I can’t tell one twin from the other.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “We attribute the rise to training.”
rewrite.answer: The rise is attributed to training.

rewrite.prompt: Ativa: “The loss is attributed to errors.” (They…)
rewrite.answer: They attribute the loss to errors.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com tell…from: “I can’t see the difference between the twins.” (one twin / other)
rewrite.answer: I can’t tell one twin from the other.
